replies.text: Good point. That line was actually planned years before the data center, partly to improve regional transmission capacity. comments.text:
I started off with a 14.4 KW solar system on my roof.  It cost me $40k minus the 30% I got back in taxes.  Then the power company went to the PUC for Idaho, and they let them change the 1:1 net metering to net-billing.  So, I bought an EG4 18kpv and installed 64KW of batteries.  Now I don't buy power from the grid at all, but the corruption is amazing.  Every KW that I make during winter pricing, they give me only 2.9 cents.  They sell that same KW for 12.9 cents to my neighbor.  My bill should still be taken care of since on sunny days, I'm still exporting 50 KW, but that equates to $1.50 per day that the sun is shining.  It might cover their $15 service charge.  When I divide what I've spent by my $300 power bill I get 133 months, then I divide by 12 to get 11.11 years to the point where my system has paid itself off.
People need to look at their choices.  I know a lot of people have to rent now, but if you don't rent, do what I did.
I don't even buy gas since my cars are both electric.  I own a 2013 Chevy Volt and a 2025 Chevy Equinox EV.  Stop letting the gas and diesel people control you!!
